description: Count business days between two dates, or add/subtract N business days from a date, skipping weekends and (optionally) the country's official public holidays. Returns the holidays skipped. Exact; do not do this in your head.

add_days.description: Or: number of business days to add (negative to subtract)

country.description: ISO country code for holidays, e.g. US, GB, DE (optional)

end.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (to count business days between)

name: business_days
title: Count or add business days (with public holidays)
